surveyor.jaymoskingdoms.design.how: Use the rod on two opposite corners of something you built (take in its floor), then save it at a mason's table.
surveyor.jaymoskingdoms.plot.how: Use the rod on two opposite corners of the ground the builders may build on.
surveyor.jaymoskingdoms.field.how: Use the rod on two opposite corners of a field. A farmer is taken on to harvest and sow it.
surveyor.jaymoskingdoms.quarry.how: Use the rod on two opposite corners on the ground; click lower down for the second corner to set how deep. Miners dig it out layer by layer.
surveyor.jaymoskingdoms.storage.how: Use the rod on a chest or barrel to add it to the settlement's storage, or to take it out.
